_about: Bibliography for thresholds.json and inflight_measurements.json. Every threshold and measurement references ids from here. 'checked' = date the URL was opened and the cited value confirmed in the text (or by a research agent in this repo, see DATA_SOURCES.md).

ada_diagnosis.title: ADA — Diagnosis (fasting glucose: normal <100, prediabetes 100–125, diabetes ≥126 mg/dL)

osdr_osd575.title: NASA OSDR OSD-575 — Inspiration4 Comprehensive Metabolic Panel with lab reference ranges (glucose 65–99 mg/dL); local copy data/nasa/osd575_inspiration4_cmp_long.csv

nasa_curiosity_dose.title: NASA — Curiosity results: Mars surface 0.67 mSv/day

nasa_mars_comm.title: NASA fact sheet — Mars communications disruption and delay (up to ~22 min one way)

bmj_open_2026.title: BMJ Open 2026 — NASA astronaut cohort profile: weekly Private Medical Conference, annual physical

petersen_2016.title: Petersen et al. 2016 — ISS exercise: Periodic Fitness Evaluation at FD15 then monthly, 2.5 h/day scheduled

ntrs_standard_measures_2023.title: NTRS 20230014025 — Standard Measures During Spaceflight: L-180, L-90, FD30, R-30

basner_2024.title: Cognition battery on 6-month ISS missions (2024): 10 subtests, ~FD30 and ~R-30

ntrs_ooha_2012.title: NTRS 20120010555 — JSC audiology: On-Orbit Hearing Assessment within FD14 then every 60 days (2012)

csa_radiation.title: CSA — Monitoring radiation for astronaut health (2026): neutrons ~30% of total ISS radiation; CANS neutron spectrometer. Official challenge resource.

csa_why_science.title: CSA — Why do we conduct science experiments in space? Deep-space risks incl. less reliance on Earth for emergency medical help. Official challenge resource.
